content: The dataset of 1,000 randomly selected tweets contains more than twice as many tweets about Trump than about the other candidates. In the named-entity recognition experiment, the average CCR of crowdworkers was 98.6%, while the CCR of the automated systems ranged from 77.2% to 96.7%. For four of the automated systems, detecting the entity Trump was more difficult than the other entities (e.g., spaCy 72.7% for the entity Trump vs. above 91% for the other entities). An example of incorrect NER is shown in Figure FIGREF1 top. The difficulties the automated tools had in NER may be explained by the fact that the tools were not trained on tweets, except for TwitterNLP, which was not in active development when the data was created BIBREF1.
